purpose: Independently inspect complete original and predictor saved runs and source snapshots as data, retaining the first failed audit and irrecoverable reference precision gaps; no new forward/optimizer/reference calls.
required_scopes: Strict finite, duplicate-free JSON and safe regular files; no symlink, overwrite, ZIP traversal or oversized member exposure.
All 24 rows per run and the 12 matched / 12 adverse split; every artifact hash and source-ZIP manifest, original refusals/exceptions and paired capture identity.
Independent observed input, settings, query, training/reserved split, seed, bounds and level-hint hashes; no current backend-source imports.
Every phase candidate prediction/residual/cost identity and objective/source-cache histories, resources and local-status consistency.

Predictor quarter quotas, skips, selection, fallback, full seven-coordinate start and phase hashes; selected literal index space, top ledgers, charged/reported work and protocol/source/unknown-work completion.
Geometry, wrapped-angle and dimension errors, saved reserved-residual maxima, target arithmetic and reported flag counts, with explicit forward/boundary/rank/stopping exclusions.

precision_policy.old_v1: Preserve source,5740807checks14failures andexit1, never rewrite normalized success.
precision_policy.per_run: Request all 24 pre-cast GL order comparisons: 10 smooth comparisons reconstructible, 14 rounded comparisons explicitly unverified. Verify rounded stored-array differences separately; do not infer discarded float64 deltas or count unverified records as passed.
precision_policy.original_reference_gate: Preserve original reportedpassed/failed claims andtargetflags asreported; qualification verification requiresmissingrawprecision and remainsincomplete.
precision_policy.overall: Any inconsistency gives status inconsistent and exit 1. No inconsistency but required unverified checks gives status consistent_with_unverified_records and exit 1. Verified-subscope counts are not scientific acceptance.

prospective_controls: Malformed/nonfinite/duplicate JSON, unsafeZIP, missing/changedartifactand source hashes.
Recorded reference delta gap remains unverified; fully observed smooth deltas checked.
freeze_policy: The complete auditor/tests/admission are committed and hashed with the coupled continuation before any new imports/tests/audit execution. Later fixes require a separate admission.
excluded: No independent forward/reserved prediction/reference generation, boundary discrepancy/supremum, Jacobian/SVD/rank, brightness optimum or stopping calculus.
Old reserved pixels influenced initialization; reported residuals remainconditional.
not_a_new_success_target: Derive and retain 4/12 and 9/12 from saved flags. These partial counts are record identities, not success criteria.
